scope: Interactive browser prototype only; not native, backend or live Forma acceptance
method: Playwright interactions and DOM measurements in the integrated browser

groups.name: Navigation and context
checks: Enter creates a newline, not a send
Back restores row focus
Unselected conversation shows its draft
Same-person direct and organizer drafts stay separate
Draft survives conversation navigation
Folding preserves composer focus and selection
Layout changes retain composer and history DOM
Search has a clear no-match state
Search retains the active draft
Groups filter excludes direct histories
No invented direct-message unread badge
Reading a room advances only that room

groups.name: Sending and immutable retries
checks: Failed intent is immutable and locks replacement sends
Offline cannot retry
Current canSend permission gates retry
Unknown outcome retains the exact UUID/body without duplicate bubble
Resolved retry uses the same intent and unlocks composer
Offline preserves draft and prevents send
Reconnection does not auto-send
IME composition cannot trigger Ctrl+Enter send
Explicit keyboard send is labeled local-only
4001 UTF-16 units are rejected without losing draft
Malformed Unicode is rejected
Exactly 4000 UTF-16 units including emoji are accepted
Whitespace-only message cannot send

groups.name: Attachments, consent and revocation
checks: New message shows only eligible sample contacts
Escape closes dialog and restores focus
Artwork picker has images and accessible labels, no visible names
Unsent attachment never moves to another person
Attachment survives layout and context navigation
Remove attachment leaves no accidental send
Attachment-only send is explicitly local preview
Pending request cannot compose
Offline cannot accept or decline a request
Read-only cannot grant request permission
Accept enables only the sample conversation, with explicit non-server result
Invitation discloses history policy before joining
Joining does not invent or reveal old group history
Revocation removes inbox identities, avatars and message history
Revocation disables entry and hides composer
Revocation clears private dialog and attachment previews
Revocation clears all unsent attachment selections

groups.name: Stale actions and typing
checks: Stale request action rechecks current authorization
Authorized request still accepts after guarded transition
Decline removes only the chosen invitation
Stale attachment selection cannot change recipient
Read-only retains authorized history but prevents sending
Typing appears only after explicit sample trigger
Typing disappears after six seconds
Reduce Motion disables typing animation
